Rahul Gandhi alleges security withdrawn to facilitate Rajiv Gandhi's assassination

Congress leader Rahul Gandhi has alleged that the security cover for his father, former Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi, was deliberately withdrawn to facilitate his assassination. Sonia Gandhi recounted an incident from a 1991 Bihar visit where Rahul Gandhi expressed concerns about his father's security, stating that the environment was created for his father's murder. This comes amid renewed focus on the security of Gandhi family members.
